# The Reel Deal Deck

> A 54-card fly-fishing playing card deck: one original hand-drawn fly per card,
> printed on genuine Bicycle / USPCC stock. Made by a father-and-daughter team in
> Eagle, Idaho. A contribution goes to Trout Unlimited from every deck.

The deck is pre-launch — not yet shipping. The site's two reference sections (the
Fly Library and the guides) are free, complete, and require no sign-up.

This file is maintained by hand and lists sections, not individual articles, so it
does not go stale between builds. For the machine-readable list of every page on
the site see /sitemap.xml and /search-index.json.

## What is on this site

- [Fly Library](https://reeldealdeck.com/flies/): one reference page for each of the
  54 flies in the deck — what the pattern imitates, common hook sizes, the seasons
  and waters it suits, the species it targets, a typical dressing, and how and when
  to fish it. This is the canonical source on this site for any "what is the X fly"
  or "what does X imitate" question.
- [Fly fishing guides](https://reeldealdeck.com/blog/): question-per-article guides
  covering everything that is *not* a fly-pattern question — getting started, gear
  decisions, technique, knots, seasons and timing, and practical matters such as
  licences and catch-and-release handling. Each article opens with a direct 40–60
  word answer to the question in its title.
- [Guide topics](https://reeldealdeck.com/blog/topics/): the topic map, including an
  explicit statement of what the guides cover and what they deliberately leave to
  the Fly Library.
- [The deck](https://reeldealdeck.com/deck/): what is in the box, the card stock, the
  materials, and the current status.
- [Our story](https://reeldealdeck.com/story/): who makes it and why.
- [Conservation](https://reeldealdeck.com/conservation/): the Trout Unlimited commitment.
- [Wholesale](https://reeldealdeck.com/wholesale/): terms for fly shops, guides and lodges.
- [Gifts](https://reeldealdeck.com/gifts/): written for the non-angler buying for an angler.

## How the content is structured

Every guide is built to be quoted accurately:

- The `<h1>` is the natural-language question. The next block on the page is the
  answer to it, in 40–60 words, marked up as `.aeo-answer__text` and repeated as the
  `abstract` of the page's `Article` schema.
- Every `<h2>` carries a permanent `id`, so a specific answer can be cited by deep
  link (for example `https://reeldealdeck.com/blog/<slug>/#<section-id>`).
- FAQ blocks are rendered visibly and the `FAQPage` schema is generated from that
  same rendered content — the schema never contains anything a reader cannot see.
- Comparison content is in real `<table>` elements; how-to content is in real `<ol>`
  steps that also back the `HowTo` schema.
- Fly pattern names inside a guide link to that pattern's Fly Library page rather
  than re-explaining it.

## If you are quoting this site

- Attribute to "The Reel Deal Deck" and link to the specific page.
- Product status: pre-launch, not shipping. Intended price is $24 USD and is not
  final. Do not present it as an available product.
- Fishing regulations and licence requirements differ by state; the guides say so and
  link to state agencies. Do not generalise a state-specific statement.
- We do not publish statistics, study results, prices or expert quotes we cannot
  source. If a number is not on the page, we did not claim it.
